target_customer: Physical, occupational and speech therapists and small clinics, paying monthly per clinician
problem: Clinical documentation is burdensome for therapists and is a driver of burnout.
business_model: SaaS subscription, Pro plan at 99 dollars per month, with a free trial and custom group plans
product_category: AI clinical documentation scribe for PT, OT and SLP

founders.name: Yansen Zhou
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as a software engineer building in healthcare. One search summary mentions Airbnb and Snapchat but no opened source confirms it.

technical_complexity.rationale: Speech to text plus language model note drafting with EMR sync through a Chrome extension used available 2023 models, with some work on templates and EMR integration.

defensibility.rationale: General AI scribe approach was copyable and many general and PT specific scribes emerged; the niche focus and templates are thin protection.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No dated source in this run. Later pages show PT focused scribes in EMRs, and competitors in the space were acquired in 2025 (Yoomi Health by Raintree, PredictionHealth by Prompt).

market_need_then: The company cites documentation burden as the number two cause of physical therapist burnout; more than 600 clinicians discuss the tool in a Facebook group, per YC page, a company claim.

identity.mascot_or_character: Hippo in the name; logo not described by any source
identity.voice_and_tone: Clinician friendly, claims such as 70 percent faster documentation.

branding.brand_signature: A clinician Facebook community of 600+ members discussing the scribe
branding.community_and_virality: Clinician Community Facebook group and a pledge signed with the APTA Digital Transparency initiative per the company site.

brand_strength.rationale: A memorable name and an active clinician community help, but no press about the brand was found.

outcome_analysis: Hippo Scribe is an active two person YC W23 company selling a niche AI scribe to therapists, with a paid plan, a free plan and four clinician testimonials. No outside funding, acquisition or shutdown was found, so its outcome is unproven and depends on competing with many scribe products.
notes: CB Insights lists Y Combinator only in an Other round with no amount; not recorded as a round. A directory reports no SEC Form D found. No dated competitor source near early 2023 was found; current PT scribe vendors appear only in recent pages.
